name: Bytepaper Click-to-Chat Widget
author: abracket

sections.description:
Bytepaper WhatsApp Chat Widget allows you to easily add a floating WhatsApp chat button to your website. Visitors can instantly start a conversation with you via WhatsApp on desktop and mobile devices.

The plugin is lightweight, secure, and built following WordPress coding standards. It does not load unnecessary scripts or external resources.

Perfect for business websites, service providers, agencies, and online stores who want direct communication with visitors.

Key Features

  • Floating WhatsApp chat button
  • Custom phone number support
  • Customizable default message
  • Desktop and mobile URL support
  • Open link in same tab or new tab
  • Lightweight and optimized
  • Fully translatable
  • No external libraries or tracking
  • Loads assets only when required

Third-Party Service & Privacy

This plugin connects to WhatsApp (wa.me) to facilitate chat. No user data is stored on our servers, but the user’s phone number and message are passed to WhatsApp’s API to initiate the conversation.

Your use of this service is subject to WhatsApp’s legal terms:
* WhatsApp Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
* WhatsApp Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → WhatsApp Chat Widget.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp phone number and configure options.
  5. Save changes.

The chat button will appear on the front-end automatically.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WhatsApp Business?

No. It works with both regular WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business accounts.

What format should I use for the phone number?

Enter your full international number without spaces or special characters.
Example: 919876543210

Does it slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads assets when a phone number is configured.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Yes. The chat button works properly on both desktop and mobile devices.

Does it use external scripts or tracking?

No. The plugin does not use any tracking scripts or external font libraries.
